name: Grivei Explorer · A · Graf
note: Design tokens read off the A · Graf screens. The first ten colours and the three font stacks are the same values as :root in site/styles.css, under the same names.

bgDot.use: dot grid on the page background: 1px dots every 24px

panel.use: cards, inputs, the map panel, the Go-to card

line.use: hairlines, row dividers, card borders, bar tracks, the selected segment of a toggle

lineStrong.use: control borders: inputs, filter chips, toggles, tooltips

muted.use: labels, meta lines, counts beside tabs

idle.use: hollow marks and dashed lines only; too faint for text

accent.use: links, the headline total, active tab, active lens, bars, top map class

onAccent.use: text on an accent fill; search highlight text

directPurchase.use: direct-purchase edges in the counterparty graph

map.rampUse: five classes, low to high; one hue, darker means less on a dark surface

none.use: no matching Records, or no purchases in a zoomed county

gap.use: stroke between areas: the colour of the surface the map sits on

highlight.use: outline of the hovered or picked area

coverage.knownGapPattern: 45 degree stripes, 3px each; never colour alone

font.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

layout.columns: two flex columns that wrap; they stack once each would be narrower than about 520px
layout.wideTables: scroll inside their own box on narrow screens
